newsitem.title: USA: Circuit City to offer common stock in Carmax unit.
newsitem.headline: Circuit City to offer common stock in Carmax unit.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc on Friday said it intends to make a public offering of 15 to 20 percent of its Carmax unit, pending shareholder approval.

Circuit City, a consumer electronics concern, said it will redesignate its existing common shares of Circuit City to reflect the the performance of its retail operations and the remaining 80 to 85 percent of the Carmax unit.
Circuit City said it filed a preliminary proxy statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Shareholders will vote on the plan in late January or early February.
The firm said it would use proceeds from the offering to finance part of the CarMax's expansion and to repay the CarMax Group's allocated portion of the company's indebtedness.
Circuit City said the two operations will remain a single corporation with shared management.
CarMax is an automotive retail business.
